title: OpenCode Roadmap Queue Item v1
description: Schema for a single queue item in .rig/roadmap/queue.jsonl consumed by the OpenCode Idle Lane Steward.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this queue item.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this queue item.

status.description: Current status of the queue item.

prompt_path.description: Relative path to the prompt file under .rig/roadmap/prompts/.

title.description: Human-readable title for the OpenCode task.

allowed_files.description: Files this task is allowed to touch.

forbidden_files.description: Files this task must never touch.

required_gates_before.description: Gate artifact paths that must pass before this task can run.

targeted_tests.description: Targeted test paths to run for this task.

stop_on_dirty_overlap.description: If true, reject the task when dirty state overlaps allowed_files without an active lane claim.

max_next_tasks.description: Maximum number of continuation tasks this item may spawn.

max_continuations.description: Maximum number of times this task may be continued by the steward.

max_failed_attempts.description: Maximum number of failed attempts before blocking.

continuation_count.description: Number of times the steward has launched this task.

failed_attempts.description: Number of failed attempts for this task.

required_artifacts.description: Artifact paths that must exist for this task to be considered complete.

required_report_fields.description: Report fields that must be present in the final report.

final_report_path.description: Path where the final report must exist.

schema_validation_required.description: Whether schema validation must pass for completion.
